title: Lexicon sentiment with negation, aggregated by speaker
source:
"""Lexicon sentiment with a negation window, aggregated by speaker type.

Tokenisation is the whole game in lexicon scoring, so it follows the stated
regex exactly: `[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?` on lowercased text. That keeps "don't" as
one token (so it can act as a negator) and splits "Demand-driven" into two.

A sentiment word flips polarity when ANY of the three preceding tokens is a
negator - once, not once per negator ("not never strong" is still just
flipped). Scores are (pos - neg) / (pos + neg), zero when a segment has no
sentiment words at all, and speaker scores are plain means of segment scores.
"""
import json
import os
import re

import pandas as pd

DATA = "/input/environment/data"
OUT_DIR = "/app/output"
TOKEN = re.compile(r"[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?")
WINDOW = 3


def score_segment(text: str, pos: set, neg: set, negators: set) -> tuple[int, int, int, float]:
    tokens = TOKEN.findall(text.lower())
    n_pos = n_neg = 0
    for i, tok in enumerate(tokens):
        if tok not in pos and tok not in neg:
            continue
        flipped = any(w in negators for w in tokens[max(0, i - WINDOW):i])
        positive = (tok in pos) != flipped
        n_pos += positive
        n_neg += not positive
    total = n_pos + n_neg
    return len(tokens), n_pos, n_neg, (n_pos - n_neg) / total if total else 0.0


def main() -> None:
    with open(f"{DATA}/lexicon.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        lex = json.load(fh)
    pos, neg, negators = set(lex["positive"]), set(lex["negative"]), set(lex["negators"])
    with open(f"{DATA}/segments.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        segments = json.load(fh)

    rows = []
    for s in segments:
        n_tokens, n_pos, n_neg, score = score_segment(s["text"], pos, neg, negators)
        rows.append({"segment_id": s["segment_id"], "company": s["company"], "quarter": s["quarter"],
                     "speaker_type": s["speaker_type"], "n_tokens": n_tokens,
                     "n_positive": n_pos, "n_negative": n_neg, "score": score})
    table = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("segment_id").reset_index(drop=True)

    gaps = []
    for (company, quarter), g in table.groupby(["company", "quarter"], sort=True):
        mgmt = float(g.loc[g["speaker_type"] == "management", "score"].mean())
        analyst = float(g.loc[g["speaker_type"] == "analyst", "score"].mean())
        gaps.append({"company": company, "quarter": quarter, "management_score": mgmt,
                     "analyst_score": analyst, "gap": mgmt - analyst})

    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    table.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "segment_scores.csv"), index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "speaker_gap.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(gaps, fh, indent=2)
    assert len(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "segment_scores.csv"))) == len(segments)
    print(f"{len(table)} segments, {len(gaps)} company-quarters")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
